channel.title: DOOMCON — index moves
channel.description: The AIpocalypse, instrumented. Five pillars of public data, one 0-100 score and one level, recomputed hourly. No model scores it and no human votes on it — every number is reproducible from a published receipt.

item.title: DOOMCON 4 · 40.9 (+4.2)
item.description: Score 36.8 to 40.9 (+4.2) at 2026-09-26 11:19:57 UTC. DOOMCON measures how much is happening, not how bad it is. Levels describe observable activity tempo against this index’s own record. They are not a probability of harm.
